spec.description: Read the mail that arrived overnight and show what needs attention. Reads only: it sends, drafts and books nothing.

activation.when: Use for the morning mail triage: what arrived since yesterday and what needs an answer.

lookbackHours.description: How far back to look, in hours (24 when not given)

steps.description: Search recent mail and show it.
steps.instruction: Load the m365-mail skill and call mail_search with no query and sinceHours set to the lookbackHours input (24 when it was not given). The mail card is shown by the tool. Then write a short summary for the member in three groups: needs a reply today, for information, can wait. Name the sender and subject of each item. Use only mail_search and, when a preview is not enough to judge a message, mail_read. Never send, draft or book anything in this playbook. Finish the step with step_complete.
